Description: Date on which the collision occurred.

Number of cyclists injured in the collision.
Number of cyclists killed in the collision.
Number of motorists (drivers and passengers) injured in the collision.
Number of motorists (drivers and passengers) killed in the collision.

Factor contributing to the collision for vehicle 4 (if applicable).
